subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: This 7-day tour flies Manila to Changsha via Guangzhou on China Southern Airlines and spends four nights in Zhangjiajie. Highlights are the Avatar scenic area (Hallelujah Mountain), Qixing Mountain with a 2-hour skiing experience, and the glass skywalk. You stay in 5-star hotels with a private coach and an English-speaking guide. The package includes shop visits.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 30–Jan 5 2026 to Feb 25–Mar 3 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Guangzhou – Changsha
items: Fly Manila to Guangzhou (CZ398, 17:45/20:20), then connect to Changsha (CZ5592, 23:00/00:35+1)
Meet your tour guide and transfer to the hotel (meals: none)
Overnight: 5-star hotel in Changsha

itinerary.title: Changsha – Zhangjiajie, Qixing Mountain skiing
items: Breakfast at the hotel, then drive to Zhangjiajie
Lunch, then Qixing Mountain Scenic Area (battery car, 1520 Platform and glass skywalk included)
2-hour skiing experience (ski equipment included, snow suit not included); if the ski resort is closed due to weather, Qixing Mountain and skiing are replaced by the indoor ski at Snow and Ice World
Dinner, then back to the hotel (meals: B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie city sights
items: Breakfast at the hotel
Optional tour: Tianmen Mountain (cable car, glass skywalk, Tianmen Cave), USD 85 per person
Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum
72-floor Stilts Tower (outside view)
Dinner, then back to the hotel (meals: B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Avatar scenic area
items: Breakfast at the hotel
Compulsory shopping stop: Chinese medicine shop
Avatar scenic area (up and down by Bailong Lift or Tianzishan cable car)
No. 1 Bridge
Avatar Hallelujah Mountain
Golden Whip Stream and Water Around Four Gates
Optional tour: Charming Xiangxi Show, USD 70 per person
Dinner, then back to the hotel (meals: B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie culture and shopping
items: Breakfast at the hotel
Compulsory shopping stop: latex shop
Optional tour: Grand Canyon C Line, Glass Bridge and VR, USD 75 per person
Tea tasting at a tea shop or a visit to a silk shop
Xibu, the largest folk-culture walking street
Dinner, then back to the hotel (meals: B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Changsha
items: Breakfast at the hotel
Compulsory shopping stop: jewelry shop
Optional tour: Huanglong Cave (including cruise), USD 70 per person
Drive to Changsha
Free time for shopping on Huangxin Road walking street
Dinner, then back to the hotel (meals: B/L/D)

placeDesc.Qixing Mountain: A scenic area near Zhangjiajie with a battery car, viewing platforms and a ski experience in winter.
placeDesc.1520 Platform: A viewing platform at Qixing Mountain, visited together with the glass skywalk.
placeDesc.Glass Skywalk: A glass-floored walkway at Qixing Mountain with views down the mountainside.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum showing paintings made from local Zhangjiajie sandstone.
placeDesc.72-Floor Stilts Tower: A tall stilt-style tower building in Zhangjiajie, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie Avatar Scenic Area: A scenic area of towering sandstone pillars that inspired the floating mountains of the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator that carries visitors up the cliff face to the scenic area.
placeDesc.Tianzishan Cable Car: A cable car taking guests up to the Tianzi Mountain viewpoints, as an alternative to the lift.
placeDesc.No. 1 Bridge: A natural stone arch bridge linking two cliffs at the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The pillar peak that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic valley stream walk beneath tall rock walls in Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Water Around Four Gates: A scenic stretch of the Golden Whip Stream walk, visited on the same day.
placeDesc.Xibu Walking Street: A large walking street in Zhangjiajie with local food, crafts and folk culture.
placeDesc.Huangxin Road Walking Street: A pedestrian shopping street in Changsha with free time for shopping.
